review_basis: formal import and theorem dependency chain
resolved_findings: Removed the covariance-shape and signed-incidence energies from the admitted DIRAC-002 action.
Restored DIRAC-003 through DIRAC-008 to the base positive C19 action chain.
Moved the cubical Clifford operator downstream: it is now a continuum square-root readout, not an action term.
Kept the exact finite-lattice spatial remainder and proved its fourth-order bound.
Mapped both native rank-four copies to the standard Dirac representation; neither copy is deleted.
Constructed both frequency signs as phase-space graphs of the same continuum square root; no new native state was added.
Selected mass by a uniqueness theorem from the native prepared rest frequency and nonnegative rest-spectrum matching, without fitting a target mass.
Derived the quadratic mass and C19 transport coefficient from the existing action before defining the continuum residual.

Proved that the full native action restricts exactly to the aligned eight-site coordinates and that arbitrary retained first variations commute with restriction; proved complementary force and momentum blocks vanish without a runtime projector.
Derived a first-order branch from the actual centered recurrence characteristic roots and the already-derived Hamiltonian square rather than inserting a continuum exponential trial mode.

Proved that the recurrence-derived branch solves the continuum centered recurrence exactly, that its complete native defect is the C19 spatial remainder, and that its generator converges to the same Dirac Hamiltonian.
Added a normalized equation residual so timestep shrinkage cannot create a trivial pass.
Kept finite-spacing and finite-timestep errors explicit and independently reproduced their bounds and refinement.
Derived oriented bond flow by varying the already-admitted native C19 action rather than defining a desired current in the action.
Proved exact local phase continuity before introducing the four-component density/current readout.
Restricted positive density to the derived positive-frequency graph and exposed its normalization instead of claiming positivity for arbitrary second-order data.
Derived the standard current as the low-momentum slope of the exact native C19 group flow using the same embedding and retained both cubical copies.
Proved the velocity operator is the exact momentum response of the already-derived Hamiltonian rather than an independently supplied current matrix.
Made the action-to-Klein-Gordon-to-Dirac square relationship explicit in the final theorem without changing the native action.
Separated the final adversarial and clean-reproduction gates from the mathematical theorem so status metadata cannot close a physical proof obligation.
Removed obsolete incidence-action modules from the production source tree.
Derived copy exchange from the existing unsigned cube permutation, proved its induced coordinate map is unique, and kept the action unchanged.
Proved separately that the signed incidence readout preserves each copy, preventing unsigned geometric translation from being mislabeled as native dynamical transport.
Restricted DIRAC-016 to the exact A-B-A translation algebra; localized motion, one-exchange-per-update and physical-purpose claims remain open.

Constructed DIRAC-017 rotation generators only from the already-derived signed cube-incidence operators and derived the unique nonzero one-half scale from their actual commutator rather than defining a spin matrix or half-angle.
Proved both native copies intertwine with the conventional four-component spin generators and exposed the two-plus/two-minus component spectrum.
Proved the native inner product is positive definite, the quarter-turn is unitary, and covariance plus unitarity uniquely characterize its positive coefficients in the native plane-rotor family.
Proved continuous unitary rotations, two-pi sign reversal, four-pi return, mass-grading compatibility, discrete quarter-turn Hamiltonian covariance, and continuous-angle Hamiltonian covariance.
Kept unrestricted localized-carrier dynamics, physical electron spin and electromagnetic claims explicitly downstream.
Classified the cubical square root only inside a named native coefficient class instead of claiming unrestricted uniqueness.
Repaired an overstrong first draft that tested each copy on the full eight-corner space; the final theorem classifies each copy independently on its own exact rank-four embedding.
Proved cubic covariance reduces the real transport coefficient matrix to a scalar and used the upstream positive mass/current orientation to select the remaining sign.
Added formal negative-orientation and reflected-axis controls showing that orientation and cubic covariance are necessary hypotheses, not decorative assumptions.
Proved the two rank-four flavor sectors exhaust the eight-corner space and intersect only at zero.

Proved the exact C19 scalar symbol has only the origin zero inside the first Brillouin zone, while explicitly excluding an exact finite-spacing first-order factorization and a universal doubling theorem.
Independently reconstructed the commutant, square identities, two-copy census and periodic-zone zero counts without adding any native field or action term.
Derived all-update positive-frequency phase evolution and finite-family spectral-density conservation from the existing centered recurrence rather than inserting a translation law.
Constructed an explicit nonzero positive-frequency eigenmode at every momentum so the transport theorem cannot pass vacuously.

Derived finite-family movement from the already-proved Hamiltonian current/group-velocity identity, proved strict massive subluminality, and independently reproduced a refining Fourier-packet diagnostic.
At DIRAC-019, kept coherent real-space Lean formalization, finite-time uniform error, native sector selection and nonlinear localized-electron motion explicitly open.
Constructed the DIRAC-020 spatial field with an explicit normalized finite Fourier frame whose orthonormality is proved from finite-character orthogonality rather than assumed or fitted.

Closed a frame/momentum-label gap by deriving momentum from each character's three axis-step phases, proving the periodic cubic basis has those exact translation phases, and restricting the transport certificate to compatible packets.

Lifted the existing positive-frequency recurrence into one coherent four-component spatial field and proved exact Parseval density and integrated-current identities without adding a translation rule, field, action term, projector or coefficient.
Proved nonzero spatial transport only when the already-derived density-weighted velocity moment is nonzero; a symmetric zero-current control prevents motion from being inferred from the packet label.
Kept the exact native C19 spatial remainder, uniform fixed-physical-time convergence, and nonlinear live-chi localized-electron motion explicitly open.
Derived the DIRAC-021 rest frequency from the action-selected DIRAC-011 coefficient and explicit zero-momentum Hamiltonian eigenstates rather than inserting a clock frequency.
Derived the doubled opposite-branch phase from the quotient of two independently proved rest phases and retained wrong-mass and same-sign controls.
Kept a pure global phase non-observable and distinguished the inverse-mass scale from the native-coordinate Compton length and any SI calibration.
Reused the DIRAC-013 Hamiltonian momentum-response velocity; no velocity matrix or oscillation rule was added.
Derived the factor-two frequency from interference of the independently proved opposite-energy phases in a normalized state.
Integrated the proved velocity expectation and proved the amplitude bound; no native position field or force was introduced.
Retained pure-branch, same-sign, incoherent-mixture and wrong-mass controls and kept localized native-electron motion outside the claim.
Followed the existing plane-wave phase along the independently derived current trajectory instead of inserting a Lorentz factor or clock rule.
Proved the directional phase velocity keeps phase fixed before using it in the group/phase reciprocity theorem.
Derived the packet-center phase rate, energy/clock reciprocity and relativistic speed factor from the existing dispersion, transport velocity and rest clock.
Surfaced the existing zitter amplitude-frequency scale lock without modifying the action, mass, speed or observable.

Derived the zitter period from the already-proved opposite-energy beat and proved one-cycle state antiperiodicity, two-cycle return, and one-cycle observable periodicity without inserting a phase reset or rotation rule.

Bridged the one-cycle/two-cycle temporal endpoints to the independently derived 2pi/4pi cubical spinor endpoints on both retained copies while proving the temporal and spatial generators remain distinct.

Constructed the longitudinal velocity operator only from the existing Hamiltonian momentum responses, proved its square and same-state moments, and derived the exact equality between its normalized rms fluctuation and the independently derived moving clock ratio without adding a velocity, clock or hidden-path rule.
Constructed Lorentz boosts from the existing cubical alpha operators and proved their algebra, finite inverse, mass shell, density and current without changing the native action.
Constructed the Pauli-Lubanski invariant from those boost and rotation generators and derived the spin-one-half value rather than supplying it as a label.
Derived the infinitesimal Wigner-Thomas one-half coefficient from the mixed boost product and proved its uniqueness on a nonzero witness.

Constructed free charge conjugation as an explicit anti-linear involution and proved frequency plus momentum reversal on both native copies without asserting electric charge or an interacting positron.
Derived the Gordon current decomposition from the established gamma algebra and free on-shell equations without adding an electromagnetic field, Pauli term, magnetic moment or g factor.
